name: agent-runtime-receipts
description: Open runtime receipts for AI agent costs, performance, and outcomes.

scripts.clean: find packages examples -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find packages examples -type f -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test packages/core/dist/*.test.js packages/openrouter/dist/*.test.js packages/x402/dist/*.test.js packages/ori/dist/*.test.js
